children.value: Chief Alex has a favor to ask of you. Go see Alex.
Alex wants you to scout out the Cygnus Knight Stronghold, as they seem to be on the move. Report to Alex after scouting out the Cygnus Knight Stronghold.
The stronghold's security was tight. You'll need to find a way in...
Alex wants to rescue Neinheart. Speak with Chief Alex.
You rescued Neinheart, but he stayed behind. Everyone has their own way of working towards peace.
Alcaster says he has a favor to ask of you regarding #p2160000#.

Alcaster has placed his magic power in the Crystal to release #p2160000#'s curse. Alcaster claims that using this Crystal near #p2160000# will break the curse of the Lion King. Go to where #p2160000# is and use Alcaster's Crystal.

You have broken the curse of the Lion King that was placed on #p2160000#! #p2160000#, as a token of his gratitude, says he will give you armor and a weapon he found in the castle if you bring him the #b#t4310009##k and #b#t4310009##k.
Well, what are they up to? Huh! So, they've tightened security...
Hm, I need to find out what they're doing. I still need your help...
You haven't been by the stronghold yet? We can't keep wasting time...
Okay. We need to rescue Neinheart. Please give us your help again.
Neinheart alone resisted the Black Mage's influence. If we can save him, we might have a fighting chance against Cygnus. Go save him from the Secret Grove.
Neinheart is the only Cygnus Knight who didn't turn bad. How can you just abandon him?
I've delivered #b#p2160000##k's letter to his family. Now, could you do me a favor?
The reason why #p2160000#'s ghost is in pain is because the Lion King placed a curse on #p2160000#. To break the curse, the link connecting the Lion King and #p2160000# must be destroyed.
Here, take this crystal. I've placed my magic power in this crystal. If you use this crystal near #p2160000#, the Lion King's curse will be broken.
I'll give you this crystal at no cost. Do be careful with it.
It's not that big a favor... Aren't you a selfish person! Tsk tsk...
It's you... Did you deliver my letter to Alcaster?
What? The curse has been broken? Amazing...
You weren't kidding... I'm not cold anymore. I'm not in pain either! I can move freely! Ha ha ha ha! Thanks a lot!
I owe Alcaster big! And you, too.
Use the crystal near #p2160000#, and the curse will be destroyed. Now, hurry to the castle and break the curse on #p2160000#.
